entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Charlie. How can I help you today?
Hi Charlie. I'm calling about an order I placed about a month ago for a pair of spin class shoes. I'd like to return them.
I can certainly look into that for you. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue with the cycling shoes? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference issue?
It's a fit issue. I've worn them a few times, and they're just not comfortable. I keep getting blisters on my heels. It's not a defect, I just don't think they're the right model for my feet.

I understand, getting blisters is definitely no fun and can ruin a ride. Just to be thorough, were the cleats installed correctly? Sometimes an improper cleat position can affect the fit and pressure points.
Yes, I had the cleats set up at my local studio. It's really just the shoe itself. I'd like to process a refund if possible.

Of course. Let me just pull up our return policy here. Okay, I see your purchase was 33 days ago. Our policy allows for returns within 90 days of delivery, so you are well within the window. I can definitely approve this return for you.
That's great, I appreciate it. Now, since these didn't work out and I'll need to buy another pair, would you be able to offer a small discount code for my next purchase as a gesture of goodwill?

I understand your request, but unfortunately, my system doesn't allow me to generate discount codes for returns related to fit or preference. However, I can get the full refund process started for you right away. I'm sending a pre-paid return label to the email on your account now.
Alright, I thought it was worth asking. A full refund is fine. Thank you for your help, Charlie.
You're very welcome. Once we receive the shoes, your refund will be processed within 3-5 business days. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Thank you for calling VeloFit. Have a great day!
